description: Native macOS runtime for SlimLO DOCX-to-PDF converter. Contains a minimal, LTO-optimized LibreOffice engine (libmergedlo.dylib), the SlimLO C API (libslimlo.dylib), and the slimlo_worker process for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x64). Built from vanilla LibreOffice source with 30 idempotent patch scripts. Uses Quartz VCL backend and CoreText for font rendering. No additional system dependencies required.
